research_question: What contemporaneous source-backed mechanisms make same-day lithium spot spreads an invalid proxy for Livent/converter realized margin in the 2019 cycle, and what temporal dimensions must a defensible margin reconstruction preserve?
minimum_publishable_claim: For the grounded 2019 Livent context, same-day spot input/output prices must not be presented as realized converter margin because product pricing can be governed by long-term fixed/formula contracts with delayed or absent cost pass-through, while inventory and revenue/cost recognition introduce separate vintages.

required_fragments: long-term contracts for most products are often fixed or formula-based and may not permit increased costs to be passed through immediately or at all
2019 inventory categories and FIFO accounting / matching of cost of sales with related revenues
decision to carry up to 4,000 metric tons of hydroxide inventory into 2020 to meet higher customer commitments
favorable product/customer mix and lower third-party carbonate costs affected EBITDA

temporal_dimensions_to_preserve: raw-material cost basis and reset period

numeric_reconstruction_gate.upgrade_only_if: A claim-scoped filed contract or issuer disclosure exposes sufficiently exact lithium-specific purchase and/or sale pricing/reset formula plus the relevant volume/inventory timing.
numeric_reconstruction_gate.reason: A numeric spread reconstructed from unmatched spot series would create false precision and violate the benchmark's purpose.

acceptance: Archive exact source bytes through an approved direct or authoritative-redistributor lane with SHA-256 and honest retrieval provenance.
Persist claim-scoped Evidence for contract pass-through and inventory-vintage mechanisms without automatic Fact/Judgment promotion.
Represent the resulting industrial-memory semantics without treating accounting policy as a timeless universal rule.
Demonstrate point-in-time visibility using source-supported known-times.
Do not search any unsealed shard or mutate sealed blind-memory artifacts.
Do not build generic margin infrastructure unless this real trajectory exposes a concrete missing primitive.

initial_discovery_result.sec_2019_10k_contract_risk: Confirmed: Livent states it enters long-term contracts for most products, often fixed or formula-based, and may be unable to pass increased costs through immediately or at all.
initial_discovery_result.sec_2019_10k_inventory: Confirmed: 2019 filing reports finished/semi-finished/raw-material inventory and a FIFO accounting change intended to improve matching of cost of sales with related revenues.
initial_discovery_result.q3_2019_inventory_build: Confirmed in issuer results redistribution: Livent revised guidance to carry up to 4,000 metric tons of hydroxide inventory into 2020 to meet higher customer commitments.
initial_discovery_result.exact_contract_formula: Not yet established; remains optional numeric-upgrade research and is not required for the minimum publishable nonnumeric benchmark.
